seoTitle: IPv4 Subnet Mask Cheat Sheet (CIDR /8 to /32)
metaDescription: Reference table of IPv4 prefixes from /8 to /32 with subnet mask, wildcard mask, address count and usable hosts.
intro: Look up a netmask or host count without calculating it.
why:
The table lists each prefix length with its dotted subnet mask, wildcard (inverse) mask, total addresses and usable hosts (addresses minus network and broadcast, except /31 point-to-point and /32 host routes). Values were checked against Python's ipaddress module. You can narrow the range of prefixes.

It covers IPv4 only. For specific networks use the subnet calculator.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Use the wildcard mask for ACLs and OSPF statements.
Open the subnet calculator for a specific network.
